themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or as research partners, focusing on their infrastructure, capabilities, and applications.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with coding tasks, including code generation, debugging, and research support.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, recruitment, skills, and the overall professional landscape.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and tools specifically designed for conducting research, from data analysis to platform development.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, impact, and challenges of AI chatbots in various user interactions and research contexts.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Details AI's role in automating testing processes across software development, product deployment, and quality assurance.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare and evaluate different AI research tools based on their features, performance, and use cases.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI-generated synthetic users or consumers for testing, research, and simulating real-world interactions.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in the design process, including AI-driven design systems, generative design, and AI's influence on design workflows.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to derive insights from customer data, personalize experiences, and improve customer support and engagement.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
